articles.text: The playing court shall be measured and marked as shown in the Court Diagram.
A team's basket consists of the basket ring and its net through which the ball must pass to score. The basket that a team defends is its own basket.
Blocking is illegal personal contact which impedes the progress of an opponent with or without the ball.
Charging is illegal personal contact, with or without the ball, by pushing or moving into an opponent's torso.
A player shall not be the last to touch the ball before it goes out-of-bounds.
A player shall not run with the ball without dribbling it.
A player in control of the ball who steps on or over the restricted area arc must have both feet on the floor.
A player shall not hold, push, charge into, or impede the progress of an opponent by extending a hand, arm, leg or knee.
A player who is moving with the ball is required to stop or change direction to avoid contact if an opponent has established a legal guarding position in his path.
If a player with the ball makes contact with an opponent in a legal guarding position, it is a charging foul.
An official may assess a technical foul for unsportsmanlike conduct including profanity, disparaging remarks, or physical contact with an official.
